column3: MicroCell WP2: group 1, remove the __main__ harness blocks and the dead parent imports (base, mixed); file the WP2 session prompt
MicroCell WP2: group 2 (part), remove the pointwise spring mode and the spring_pointwise setting; parity test checks removed settings against their frozen value
MicroCell WP2: group 3, remove the legacy_patch_v1 and hertz_summit_v1 contact laws and the settings only they read; full-film result tag contact_model is 'off'
MicroCell WP2: group 4, remove the Roelands and compressibility stubs (roelands_eta_dim, rho_nd, eta_nd)
MicroCell WP2: group 5, remove the gauge_lift setting and the c2 cavitation form
MicroCell WP2: group 6, remove the solver's export hooks (export_vtk, XDMF series, post_process, output_dir) and the ignored constructor arguments mesh_h and k
MicroCell WP2: group 7, remove the warm-start plumbing (warm_start_state, warm_start_snapshot, set_pair_warm, pair_warm_record and the pair warm levels)
MicroCell WP2: group 8, remove contact_only_load and the contact-table tag; the pair branch is selected by the plain flag pair_branch
MicroCell WP2: group 9, remove the solver's environment reads (MICRO_DEBUG_LOG, MICRO_NONDIM_DIAG, MICRO_UREF_FLOOR_OMEGA, MICRO_EPSP_ND_CAP, MICRO_SPOS_FORM), each frozen at its unset value
